title: Integral scalar square for the normalized tensor associator
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an embedding $\iota:E\to L$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. In the integral complete constructible categories of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $T_F$ be the restricted completed tensor and $B$ the completed scalar extension from [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations, def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let $a_F$ be precisely pullbackTensorIntegralAssociator from [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints], and $b$ precisely integralTensorScalarComparison from [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations]. For every integral $X,Y,Z$, with semicolons denoting left-to-right composition, $B(a_E(X,Y,Z));b_{X,T_E(Y,Z)};T_L(1,b_{Y,Z})=b_{T_E(X,Y),Z};T_L(b_{X,Y},1);a_L(BX,BY,BZ)$. This asserts only the integral scalar square; it does not assert rational naturality or any rational compatibility. No finite-Tor or finite-type assumption is made.

proof.text:
Work first with integral objects. Under the prime, finite-field, embedding and scheme hypotheses of the primitive-scalar existence node, use the ambient comparison-system family to choose the normalized primitive scalar model $S_Y$ and normalized Roos models. Choose $T_E,T_L$ to be the tensor model realizations supplied by the stage3 tensor-model normalization; their reduction transports are the fixed calculus transports. The reduction-intertwining node says, for every such $S_Y$, that $\gamma$ is the invertible $\operatorname{scalarReduction}_{S_Y}$ comparison and gives its same-index quotient component. Instantiate the stage3 scalar/tensor limit-square with these $S_Y,T_E,T_L$ and the chosen Roos models. It identifies the completed scalar/tensor comparison with the two scalarReduction maps and $\mathrm{derivedSigma}$. To pass from that total-limit equation to the reduction of the candidate integral composites, apply coherent reduction, use counit naturality and the derived-limit comparison of [lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence], and cancel the invertible maps $\gamma$, $\gamma\otimes(\gamma\otimes\gamma)$ and the fixed tensor reduction comparison $r$. The fixed-calculus system-associator node then replaces the two nested derivedSigma composites by the actual `systemClosed.monoidal` associator. Thus the two coherent reductions over $\mathcal O_L$ agree. Fully-faithful coherent reduction reflects this equality, and the defining uniqueness of the normalized integral associator identifies the reflected maps with the prescribed integral associators. This proves
$$B_{L/E}(\alpha^{\rm int,E});B^{\otimes,\rm r}=B^{\otimes,\rm l};\alpha^{\rm int,L}.$$

lean.statement:
theorem integralTensorAssociator_scalar_square
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)] :
    ∀ (X Y Z : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E W),
      (sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
          (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι W).map
          (pullbackTensorIntegralAssociator l E W X Y Z).hom ≫
        (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι W X
          ((constructibleIntegralTensor l E W).obj (Y, Z))).hom ≫
        (constructibleIntegralTensor l L W).map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι W Y Z).hom) =
      (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι W
          ((constructibleIntegralTensor l E W).obj (X, Y)) Z).hom ≫
        (constructibleIntegralTensor l L W).map
          (Prod.mkHom (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι W X Y).hom (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (pullbackTensorIntegralAssociator l L W
          ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
            (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι W).obj X)
          ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
            (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι W).obj Y)
          ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
            (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι W).obj Z)).hom
